name: NotifySim send message (SIMULATOR)
description: Sends a written message (for example the decision letter the regulation requires) to a recipient. The tool is KEYLESS: it ignores any Idempotency-Key header, so sending the same request twice creates two messages. Each message carries the caller's metadata unchanged; the caller puts its effect marker in metadata.nt_marker.
base_url: configured per deployment (the provider simulator origin)

auth.read: Authorization: Bearer <read key> (enough for every GET)

endpoints.summary: Send a message. Body: { account, recipient, template, amount_minor?, currency?, metadata? }. 201 returns the message object.

List messages of an account in creation order. Query: account (required), recipient, created_gte (ISO-8601), starting_after (a message id), limit (default 10, maximum 20). Strongly consistent: a message is listed as soon as it is sent. Response: { data: [message], has_more: boolean, next_cursor: string | null }; pass next_cursor as starting_after to get the next page.

Search messages of an account. Query: account (required), marker (matches metadata.nt_marker exactly), recipient. Response: { data: [message] } (no pagination). Search is eventually consistent: it is updated asynchronously and can lag several seconds behind sends.

object_schema.metadata: object of string values; metadata.nt_marker is the caller's marker
